item.title: Vienna Boys’ Choir to perform live in Manila this April
item.description: Music lovers in the Philippines are in for a rare treat as the Vienna Boys’ Choir returns to the country for a pair of special performances this April. item.title: State Ballet of Georgia brings 'The Nutcracker' to Sands Theatre for a festive Singapore run
item.description: The world-renowned State Ballet of Georgia is set to return to Singapore later this year with a staging of the beloved holiday classic The Nutcracker, bringing a magical start to the festive season at Sands Theatre, Marina Bay Sands. The production will run from 26 to 29 November, following the company’s sold-out Singapore season of Swan Lake in 2025.
